Your declaration now travels with the check — and makes the report complete.

**New**

- Components you declared in `jochwacht-deps.yaml` keep their
  supplier/license/purl/cpe in the payload (`source_type: "declared"`).
  Discovered components still transmit names, versions and ecosystems
  only. Opt out with `--no-declared-metadata`; `--dry-run` shows the
  exact payload either way.
- Declared `purl` and `cpe` entries are no longer dropped by the
  parser — a declared CPE makes the component checkable against the NVD
  in your report.
- `--lang de|en` chooses the report language explicitly. Default: the
  language of the landing page your code was issued on (German if
  undeterminable).

**Why:** measured on a real Zephyr/Zynq project, the old collector
reduced 58 declared licenses to 17 database reconstructions and left
every declared CPE unused. A declaration is written for SBOM purposes —
throwing it away degraded your report.
